summary: BodyIQ-AI full-stack testing complete. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass (lead CRUD per source, invalid source/email rejection, admin login/logout/stats/list/CSV export, Bearer auth). Frontend: all 7 pages render, email captures submit on Home/Demo/Training/Forensic, Contact form stores lead, Admin password flow works end-to-end with 13 leads + stats + filter pills + CSV export link + logout. Demo variants (default Negotiation / Field Training) swap correctly; play/prev/next/timeline controls all functional. No Mongo _id leak in API responses.
critical_code_review_comments: ADMIN_TOKENS is in-memory (expected per PRD) — restarts log out all admins. Acceptable for lightweight admin but could use short-lived JWT or Mongo-backed tokens if scaled.

TrainingPage.handleReserve inserts synthetic 'unknown+{ts}@reservation.local' rows before Stripe redirect — pollutes leads DB without real signal. Recommend either collecting email first or marking these with metadata.reservation_pending and filtering from admin view.
Admin CSV export passes token via query string (necessary for anchor download) — ensure server logs don't capture full URL in access logs to avoid token leakage.
EmailCapture client-side validation is only '@' substring check; server-side EmailStr handles strict validation (422) — OK, just noting the discrepancy in UX.
No rate limiting on POST /api/leads or /api/admin/login — admin password brute-force surface. Consider adding slowapi or similar before production.
CORS is wildcard ('*') in .env — fine for preview, tighten to specific origins for production.
seed_data_creation: Created 13 leads in Mongo via tests + UI submissions (TEST_* prefix across all 7 sources: home, demo, demo_training, training, contact, newsletter, forensic_library).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_bodyiq_api.py (pytest). Admin token is in-memory — each pytest run calls /api/admin/login fresh. UI test note: after admin login, wait for '[data-testid^="admin-lead-row-"]' to appear (loadData is async after dashboard renders). Training prices render via toLocaleString so use '$1,500' not '$1500'. Stripe Reserve buttons redirect to placeholder buy.stripe.com URLs (not reachable) — do NOT follow the redirect in tests.
